title: Lessons learned
description: When a task keeps failing, Cobble keeps a short note of the cause. The most useful active notes (at most {{max}} are kept active) are added to the instructions of the next agents of this project so they do not repeat the mistake. Notes are plain text, stay in this project, and secrets are masked.
